e: Knowledge is light.
Patience is the key to relief.
Whoever strives shall find.

a: اَلْوَقْتُ كَالسَّيْفِ إِنْ لَمْ تَقْطَعْهُ قَطَعَكَ
z: 时间如剑，你不斩它，它便斩你。
e: Time is like a sword: if you do not cut it, it cuts you.

a: اَلْكَلَامُ مِنَ الْفِضَّةِ وَالسُّكُوتُ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ
e: Speech is silver, silence is golden.
The neighbor before the house.
Habit is a second nature.

a: اَلْعِلْمُ فِي الصِّغَرِ كَالنَّقْشِ عَلَى الْحَجَرِ
e: Knowledge learned in youth is like engraving on stone.
Truthfulness is safety.

a: اَلْإِفْلَاسُ فِي الدُّنْيَا أَهْوَنُ مِنَ الْإِفْلَاسِ فِي الْآخِرَةِ
z: 今世的破产比后世的破产容易。
e: Bankruptcy in this world is easier than bankruptcy in the Hereafter.
The tongue is a bone, but has no bone.

z: 愤怒始于疯狂，终于悔恨。
e: Anger begins with madness and ends in regret.
The best of matters is the middle course.

z: 钱是白的还是黑的？（喻财富不分善恶）
e: Is money white or black? (Wealth is indifferent)

z: 知足是永不枯竭的宝藏。
e: Contentment is an inexhaustible treasure.

z: 患难时的朋友才是真朋友。
e: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

z: 奴仆用杖打，自由人用言语。
e: A slave is beaten with a stick, a free man with a word.
There is benefit in harm.

z: 母亲是一所学校，你若培育好她。
e: The mother is a school; if you prepare her well.
Loyalty is a sun that never sets.
Strike the iron while it is hot.
Do not speak while angry.
Health is a spoil (blessing).
He who does not taste does not know.

z: 慷慨者守信，卑劣者忘恩。
e: The generous keeps promises, the vile forgets.

z: 对无知者温和，属于知识的一部分。
e: Gentleness with the ignorant is part of knowledge.
Guard your tongue and you will find rest.
Hardships reveal character.

a: لَا يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تُعْطِيَ مَا لَيْسَ عِنْدَكَ
z: 你不能给予你所没有的。
e: You cannot give what you do not have.
src: 阿拉伯谚语（又归于阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜）

z: 人们是所不知之物的敌人。
e: People are enemies of what they do not know.

z: 健康的身体里有健康的心灵。
e: A sound mind in a sound body.
src: 阿拉伯谚语（借自古希腊，广泛流传）

e: Fear of poverty makes one poor.
A man is little by himself, great through his brothers.
